the replicator dynamics of the Selten Horse game is a rich source of dynamical scenarios, which include: a) the emergence of a stable limit cycle for small values of the perturbation, b) the existence of a stable limit set for intermediate values of the perturbations, and c) the existence of an unstable limit set for high values of the pertur-bations.
(a) the replicator dynamics in the Selten’s Horse game exhibits a rich set of bifurcating scenarios, and (b) these scenarios may be classified in terms of their qualitative properties.

the learning process is robust in terms of the perturbations on the payoff matrix, but not on the learning rate.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the replicator dynamics can be used to study the learning behavior of reinforcement learning agents.

the bifurcation analysis is able to identify critical parameter combinations that may lead to unexpected learning dynamics and, therefore, to the design of more robust reinforcement learning algorithms.

, even for simple two-player normal-form games, the learning dynamics may be extremely complex and the bifurcation analysis can be a powerful tool to understand the robustness of learning dynamics in such domains.
